sources.title: OpenDoor lays off its entire India workforce of 250 amid AI push - BusinessToday
sources.description: OpenDoor sacked its entire India workforce of nearly 250 employee as artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes operations.

sources.title: Opendoor shuts India operations, relocates roles to US under AI-driven restructuring
sources.description: US-based real estate technology company Opendoor is shutting down its India operations and relocating roles to the US as part of its AI-driven Opendoor 2.0 restructuring plan announced by CEO Kaz Nejatian.
